findings.source_rule: Qase cases 19275, 10164, 10165, 10166 document same-page Previous/Next Report navigation and boundary states on Aver BO report detail.
findings.description: LT-104011 extends an existing Aver BO navigation pattern from Report Detail to Lesson Detail by reusing same-page previous/next traversal logic.
findings.positive_assertion: Clicking Previous Lesson or Next Lesson opens the adjacent lesson detail in the same browser tab.
findings.negative_assertion: Navigation must not open a new tab or route to an unrelated lesson outside the same recurring chain.

findings.source_rule: Recurring BO lesson-detail tests assume the opened lesson instance is the active edit/view target.
findings.description: BO recurring-lesson workflows already depend on target lesson identity being correct. Prev/Next navigation can regress by leaving the header, fields, or action context tied to the source lesson after navigation.
findings.positive_assertion: After navigation, the BO detail header, date/time, and lesson-specific content update to the selected adjacent lesson.
findings.negative_assertion: The page must not retain source-lesson data or stale actions while claiming to show the adjacent lesson.

findings.source_rule: The ticket describes recurring-chain navigation but does not define the no-chain case.
findings.description: The requirement does not state what happens on a one-time lesson or any lesson with no adjacent chain member: whether buttons are hidden, visible-but-disabled, or omitted entirely.
findings.positive_assertion: The design should define an explicit default state when BO Lesson Detail has no adjacent lesson to navigate to.
findings.negative_assertion: Users must not receive enabled navigation buttons that resolve to nowhere.

findings.source_rule: Detail-page action buttons are validated for visibility, enabled state, and route transition before use.
findings.description: LT-104011 adds another action-button pair to a lesson detail page, extending an existing UI pattern already used for detail-page navigation features.
findings.positive_assertion: Previous Lesson and Next Lesson appear in the BO lesson-detail action area when the feature is eligible.
findings.negative_assertion: The new buttons must not be hidden, overlapped, or rendered unusable within the existing action layout.

findings.source_rule: The reference feature defines first/last-item disabled states and report-detail wording, but LT-104011 does not restate the lesson-detail equivalent.
findings.description: The ticket says the same logic/design can be applied from LT-84885, but it does not explicitly confirm whether boundary disabled states and missing-neighbor feedback must match one-for-one on Lesson Detail.
findings.positive_assertion: First-lesson and last-lesson behavior should be explicitly defined for Lesson Detail if LT-84885 parity is required.
findings.negative_assertion: Implementation must not mix button-disable logic with undefined alerts or silent failures at the chain boundaries.

findings.source_rule: BO lesson detail is available to teacher and staff roles under the Aver CPU/SPU access model.
findings.description: The requirement does not define which BO roles can see or use the buttons even though Aver differentiates teacher CPU access from SPU location access.
findings.positive_assertion: Allowed roles should be explicitly enumerated for the button visibility and click behavior.
findings.negative_assertion: Unauthorized or out-of-scope roles must not inherit the button merely because they can open Lesson Detail.

findings.source_rule: Lesson chains include Draft, Published, Completed, and Cancelled states, but LT-104011 defines adjacency only by chain position.
findings.description: The ticket does not specify whether navigation lands on adjacent lessons regardless of status, skips Cancelled lessons, or restricts navigation to a subset of lesson statuses.
findings.positive_assertion: Adjacent-target eligibility should define whether Draft, Published, Completed, and Cancelled lessons are valid navigation targets.
findings.negative_assertion: Buttons must not navigate to excluded statuses or silently skip lessons without a documented rule.

findings.source_rule: BO Lesson Detail already hosts tabbed and action-driven teacher workflows whose state depends on the current lesson context.
findings.description: Prev/Next navigation can regress BO teacher workflow continuity if the destination lesson opens on the wrong tab or preserves stale report-tab context from the source lesson.
findings.positive_assertion: Navigation should consistently land on the intended destination lesson surface with the expected tab/view state.
findings.negative_assertion: Users must not be left on a source-lesson subview or a broken report/attendance context after moving to another lesson.

findings.source_rule: The title/body say Aver, but the translation section also supplies Core labels.
findings.description: Tenant rollout scope is ambiguous: the description says the feature is for Aver, while the translation note also defines Core labels.
findings.positive_assertion: The requirement should explicitly state whether the feature is Aver-only or should also ship to Core tenants with different labels.
findings.negative_assertion: The feature must not be released with the wrong label set or unintended tenant exposure.

findings.source_rule: Qase case 10164 expects both Previous Report and Next Report enabled when the current record sits in the middle of the chain.
findings.description: LT-104011 carries the middle-of-chain dual-enable pattern from Aver report navigation into BO Lesson Detail navigation.
findings.positive_assertion: When both adjacent lessons exist, Previous Lesson and Next Lesson are both enabled on BO Lesson Detail.
findings.negative_assertion: A middle lesson must not disable either navigation button or treat the chain as if it were at a boundary.

e2e_scenario_impact.scenario_title: Lesson Lifecycle — Create, Teach, Report, View
e2e_scenario_impact.impact: BO teacher flow now has an additional navigation surface on Lesson Detail that can change which lesson the teacher is acting on.

e2e_scenario_impact.scenario_title: Recurring Lesson — Create, Edit Chain, Delete, Calendar Drag
e2e_scenario_impact.impact: Recurring-chain adjacency is now directly traversable from BO Lesson Detail and should be asserted during BO chain review.
